name: Does trial experience impact settlement outcomes?

mainEntity.name: Does trial experience impact settlement outcomes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, insurance companies track lawyers’ trial records and negotiating strength; attorneys with real courtroom wins—like Angelo Reyes—often secure higher and faster settlements. The threat of trial can push insurers to settle for more, making trial readiness a key advantage over less-experienced competitors.angeloreyeslaw+1​
